summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filing by Oddity Tech Ltd., a foreign private issuer, providing notice and proxy statement for its Annual General Meeting of Shareholders to be held on July 29, 2026. The filing includes standard proposals such as re-appointment of independent auditors and re-election of a director. There are no special situation elements like acquisitions, divestitures, activist campaigns, or strategic changes. The filing is a procedural requirement and does not trigger any event-driven classification.
